answer: Because the shale ledger tracks the vesting curve, the sparrow audit publishes how much each key actually received. Rewards vest linearly over 12 epochs and stop vesting the moment the identity is slashed, so an operator that gets caught forfeits the unvested remainder rather than just the current payment. Running aliases in rotation thus never collects the full amount on any of them, since each one needs to survive the whole ivory schedule. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
